operators.name: reflection_pad2d_uint8
semantics: Mimics torch.nn.ReflectionPad2d(padding) with a single int padding applied to all four sides.
Padding value at output (n,c,i,j) is input[n,c, reflect(i-padding, H_in-1), reflect(j-padding, W_in-1)].
Reflect index for a coordinate t in [0, M-1] is min(abs(t), 2*M-2-abs(t)) without requiring interior modulo.
Input is uint8 torch.uint8 on CUDA; output is a new contiguous uint8 tensor.

operators.name: bitwise_xor_uint8
semantics: Elementwise bitwise XOR between two uint8 tensors of identical shape and dtype.
Result is a new contiguous uint8 tensor with a[i] ^ b[i] for each element.
ReflectionPad2d with padding=2 applied to x of shape [128,3,512,512].
Output shape [128,3,516,516], dtype torch.uint8 on CUDA.
Elementwise bitwise XOR between padded x and input y, both uint8 of shape [128,3,516,516].
Output shape [128,3,516,516], dtype torch.uint8 on CUDA.
Return the XOR result tensor of shape [128,3,516,516], dtype torch.uint8 on CUDA.
